title: The Autumn Everpix Chose a Careful Ending Over One More Month
conflicts: User and subscriber totals differ (The Verge: 55,000 users, 6,800 paid; founders' README: 50,000 incl. 7,000 subscribers; August 2013 investor report: 45,000+ and 5,500+), so the story gives no totals and uses the conversion rate and monthly sales instead. Funding is $1.8 million (TechCrunch, pre-bridge) or $2.3 million (founders, The Verge); no total is stated. Conversion is 12.4 per cent (The Verge) or 13 per cent (August report); The Verge's figure is used.
notes: The slate's framing ('loved but did not pay for') was wrong: people did pay; sales covered running costs but not salaries, and the failure was investors' doubt about growth. Wayne Fan added as third co-founder, as both The Verge and the founders' own timeline describe him. The founders' August 2013 investor report (published by them on GitHub) supplies what they knew at the time.
